name: ALGEBRAIC_DECOUPLING_VIA_NON_TRIVIAL_POLYNOMIAL_FACTORIZATION
description: Replaces the easily simplified modular arithmetic with a symmetric cubic polynomial system. The difference factors into `(x-y)(u-w)(u^2+uw+w^2-3xy)`. Because the third factor is strictly positive but not trivially so to an LLM, it prevents symbolic reduction to pure inequality. This forces models to treat the problem as a generic CSP rather than Graph Coloring, causing generic backtracking solutions to fail or TLE on N=40.
